comments.author: thejohnfreeman
comments.body: Normally these checks are supposed to use the "prior balance", i.e. the balance of the account before the transaction started executing. I just want to note that we're making an exception here. In fact, it would be easier if we could ignore the "prior balance" everywhere. The context for most helper functions is just the `ApplyView`, which does not track the "prior balance" of any account. (The transaction function in this PR is not a helper, but one day it might be.) Helpers that require a prior balance demand that it be drilled through the caller as a parameter.

reviewCommentsList.body:
I hate to do this after approving, but [John's comment](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/pull/5176#issuecomment-2455233999) raises an important point.

The reason most reserve checks use `mPriorBalance` is because that is the account's balance _before_ fees are deducted. Unless the transaction causes the account to receive XRP, that value _will_ be higher (or equal in one edge case) than the current `sfBalance` value. This is important because an account is allowed to dip into its reserves to pay fees, so we need to examine the account's balance before those fees are paid. AFAIK, this is the only transaction that can cause the transaction-sending account to receive XRP _and_ create a trustli
